notes:
- Company snapshot: mid-market product analytics platform (in-app guidance, contextual help, workflow automation).
- Primary intent: replace brittle rule-based assistants with an agentic chat assistant that can search product docs, call internal ticketing API, and perform small actions (e.g., set user flags, escalate).
- POC plan: start on Hosted API to measure latency and tool-call reliability; if meets SLO and predictable unit economics, evaluate Dedicated for reserved throughput and data isolation.
- Latency/throughput targets: first-token streaming < 300ms for 95th pct under steady load; end-to-end multi-step agent (search + 2 tool calls) < 1.2s median, < 3s 95th desired.
- Quote from product lead: "Streaming must feel instant — users drop off if initial token >300ms; and tool calls must not silently fail, we need clear retry/fallback semantics."
- Implementation notes: used simple function-calling shim that wraps ES search and internal ticketing API; observed increased latency when both search and ticket API were invoked in the same turn.
- Cost sensitivity: mid (wants to avoid 2x step-up cost vs current rule-based infra). Interested in Optimize recommendations (batching & cache) to reduce tokens and cost per action.
- Security: requires SSO/SAML for console access, audit logs for all tool-call events, and KMS-wrapped keys for any customer PII processing. EU data residency for a subset of customers.
- Risks called out in sales: unpredictable fallbacks during peak -> poor UX; unclear pricing jump to Dedicated at required throughput; open question on cold-starts for rare tool chains.
- Objections: "Why not just host embeddings + small policy model ourselves?" — response: runtime kernel optimizations, autoscaling, and ops overhead are main value props.
- Next 2 weeks: complete hosted POC with streaming + tool-call load test, gather token-cost report, and workshop Dedicated pricing shape if metrics acceptable.
